creator: Grigor Bezirganyan

Sébastien Fournier
easy_fields.citeAs: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Fournier. 2025. LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data. In Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR ’25), July 13–18, 2025, Padua, Italy. ACM, New York, NY, USA, 10 pages. https://doi.org/10.1145/3726302.3730302
easy_fields.description: LUMA is a unique multimodal dataset featuring audio, image, and textual data from 50 classes, specifically designed for learning from uncertain data. It extends the CIFAR 10/100 dataset with audio samples from three audio corpora and text data generated using the Gemma-7B Large Language Model (LLM). The dataset enables the controlled injection of varying types and degrees of uncertainty to facilitate specific experiments and benchmarking initiatives for trustworthy and robust multimodal deep learning approaches.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper extensively details the data collection methodology for images, audio, and text, including raw data sources, extraction processes, and the use of generative models.

G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper describes both automatic and manual validation (annotation) processes for audio, including the platform used, annotator demographics, and agreement rates, and machine-based validation for text.

G5_rai.reasoning: The paper discusses biases found in the generated text, efforts to mitigate them, explicitly states limitations regarding factual inaccuracies, and outlines intended use cases for benchmarking trustworthy ML.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper details a Python package for generating dataset variants, including protocols for controlling data diversity, injecting various types of sample noise, label noise, and out-of-distribution samples, and mentions future plans for extensions.
